## Findings

### Bottom line

Northbridge is a single-segment services group whose creditors depend on one operating company, so debt service rests on that company's cash generation.
Basis: NBG_2025-03-31_annual-report.pdf, page 12

### Key findings

- The group earns almost all its cash in one operating company, which concentrates creditor risk there.
Basis: NBG_2025-03-31_annual-report.pdf, page 12
- Two debt dates fall within 24 months and drive the refinancing question.
Basis: NBG_2025-03-31_annual-report.pdf, pages 43–45
- Results are published on a fixed quarterly rhythm, so new evidence arrives on a known schedule.

### Contrary evidence and what would change the view

The strongest point against concern is the steady quarterly reporting record. A refinancing announced before the first debt date would soften the view.

### Limitations

- The covenant package was not reviewed, so covenant headroom is not assessed.
Basis: NBG_2025-03-31_annual-report.pdf
- Dates after the annual report are scheduled, not confirmed, so the nearest-date list may move.
